prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production mobile puzzle game UI sprite atlas with genuine transparent background. Reference image is style reference for the green Play button. Reproduce its bright apple-green domed face, rounded horizontal rounded-rectangle silhouette, light yellow-green rim, glossy bright highlight along upper contour, darker green thick lower lip and subtle seam giving depth. No wooden border. TWO separate blank buttons arranged in two rows, generous transparent gaps: top row a large hero primary button with lush green leaf clusters and small white/yellow flowers on its left and right ends exactly like reference; bottom row the same green face and rim WITHOUT leaf/flower ornament, for Save, Next Level and other actions. Both broad, roughly 3:1 wide, front-facing, sculpted casual-game cartoon illustration, antialiased crisp polished texture. Keep middle 50% of each face smooth and empty so it can be stretched horizontally with nine-slice. Text will be drawn by code: NO text, NO icons, no lettering. No other objects or scenery. Preserve alpha around edges.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent Play button production sprite. Reference image 1 is the EXACT design target. Reproduce the reference Play button as closely as possible, only removing its text. Same broad symmetrical horizontal swollen rounded-rectangle / capsule silhouette, overall width-to-height about 2.45:1, gently convex upper and lower contours, full rounded ends. Thick apple-green domed face, soft yellow-lime thin inner rim, luminous cream highlight at upper edge, sculpted dark-green bottom edge and pleasant rounded depth. Same small white daisies with yellow centers and short rich green foliage at left and right ends. Copy the reference color and materials, no reinterpretation. It is a normal plump button: NO leaf-shaped face, NO asymmetry, NO kidney shape, NO upward curled tip, NO wood. Center broad smooth blank for live text. Single isolated button centered on true transparent canvas. No text, no letters, no arrow, no scenery, no extra ornament. Keep button face thickness and proportions of reference, flowers secondary to face.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: extracted milestone progress banner from the supplied reference. Reproduce ONLY the small cream banner beneath Play, matching its shape and proportions exactly, on a transparent background. The banner is compact (overall width about 4.1 times overall height), warm ivory face, rounded gently curved contour, thin golden/tan raised rim and subtle lower depth, small two-leaf green cluster at left, small pink/red gift with gold bow on right. Gift fits the panel height, barely overlaps top, not oversized. IMPORTANT: copy the reference banner; do not invent a long rectangular UI bar, scroll or large leaf clusters. Remove the text '13 levels to reward' and ALL seven progress leaves, leaving the smooth central cream space blank for live code. No Play button, level sign, scenery, text or other objects. Only a single faithful clean enlarged version of the reference cream progress plaque, blank central area, original proportions and pleasant sculpted cartoon texture, true transparent background.
